QuestInfo.name: Forecasting Rain
QuestInfo.1: Bruce says it's a pain not knowing when the summer rains will fall. However, certain animals have a sense about these things, so he placed #e#bBrain Wave Recorders#k#n on them. He wants to you retrieve 100 of them so he can check the weather.

0.0: Sure is hot, isn't it? And the weather is so unpredictable. Mrs. Ming Ming was just telling me that her laundry was ruined by an unexpected storm... So I thought of something. You know how monsters seem to have a sixth sense about the weather?
0.1: Well, I placed #e#bBrain Wave Recorders#k#n on a bunch of them to see how they do it. I just need someone to retrieve the recorders for me so I can compile the data. Will you collect #e#b100 Brain Wave Recorders#k#n for me?

yes.0: You'll only find Brain Wave Recorders on monsters that are between 11 levels below and 21 levels above you!

no.0: It would've been such a big help to both me and the townsfolk... Oh well.

item.0: You'll only find Brain Wave Recorders on monsters that are between 11 levels below and 21 levels above you!
